ESCALATION FIX (research-agent.yml) — exact human patch: in EACH `with:` block of the three anthropics/claude-code-action@v1 steps, add a line `allowed_bots: "github-actions"` alongside `claude_code_oauth_token:`. This allow-lists the repo's own github-actions bot (the only bot that dispatches escalations — scripts/escalate-research.js) without opening to `*` (the action warns `*` on a public repo could let external Apps invoke it with attacker-controlled prompts). The action's actor matcher strips a trailing '[bot]' and lowercases, so the bare login `github-actions` matches the github-actions[bot] actor. One line per step; restores the scout/coverage-critic -> deep research fast lane dead for months. Already documented with this exact patch in OPEN issue #430.
